proposed_widenings.name: ongoing_with_sub_activations
proposed_widenings.justification: Dispel Evil and Good is a concentration spell whose ongoing aura can be consumed by one of two optional Magic-action activations that terminate the parent spell. No current payload family supports an 'ongoing spell + optional on-demand termination actions' composite. This requires a new subgraph or a new family that composes ongoing_effect with one or more choosable activation phases.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can end the spell early by using either of the following special functions. [Break Enchantment] As a Magic action, you touch a creature... [Dismissal] As a Magic action, you target one creature...

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation.modify_roll_advantage
proposed_widenings.justification: The passive aura grants Disadvantage to attackers. OngoingOperation currently has only roll_modifier (numeric delta) and damage_on_hit. Expressing advantage/disadvantage as a persistent operation requires a new variant, analogous to the existing ModifyRollAdvantageRider in mastery but attached to an ongoing_effect operation.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you.

proposed_widenings.name: Attachment or Operation filter: creature_type_predicate
proposed_widenings.justification: The disadvantage aura only applies to attackers of specific creature types (Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, Undead). No current Attachment or OngoingOperation surface type has a creature-type filter predicate. This is a closed enum filter that gates which creatures the operation applies to.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you.

proposed_widenings.name: Effect.remove_condition (and remove_possession)
proposed_widenings.justification: Break Enchantment removes the Charmed and Frightened conditions and ends possession. The remove_condition atom exists in the v4 taxonomy but is absent from the current Effect union (DamageEffect | NoneEffect). Adding it is needed to model any condition-removal spell action.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The target is no longer possessed, Charmed, or Frightened by such creatures.

proposed_widenings.name: Effect.transport_exile
proposed_widenings.justification: Dismissal sends the target to its home plane on a failed Charisma save. The transport_exile atom exists in the v4 taxonomy but is absent from the current Effect union. This is the same atom needed for Banishment.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be sent back to its home plane if it isn't there already.

proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationCost or sub-activation cost: magic_action
proposed_widenings.justification: Both special functions cost a Magic action to activate. The current ClassFeatureActivationCost (free | bonus_action) does not include 'magic_action'. Even if sub-activations were encoded as activation phases, there is no surface type that represents 'costs the Magic action'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Magic action, you touch a creature... / As a Magic action, you target one creature...

notes: The spell is blocked at the structural level, not just the atom level. The composite shape — a concentration aura that can be voluntarily consumed by one of two distinct on-demand activations — has no analogue in any current payload family. Even if all five atom/variant gaps above were filled, the family composition itself would still need to be designed. The closest analogy is an 'ongoing_effect' with multiple choosable 'exit actions', but that subgraph does not exist in the current schema.
